representation.name: Memory Probe
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - <<'PY' > mem.txt
import os, pathlib
print('GALAXY_MEMORY_MB', os.environ.get('GALAXY_MEMORY_MB'))
print('GALAXY_MEMORY_MB_PER_SLOT', os.environ.get('GALAXY_MEMORY_MB_PER_SLOT'))
print('GALAXY_SLOTS', os.environ.get('GALAXY_SLOTS'))
for p in ['/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes']:
    if pathlib.Path(p).exists():
        print(p, pathlib.Path(p).read_text().strip())
PY
